reviews.title: I am afraid they are not made with pure silver ...
reviews.text: I am afraid they are not made with pure silver. The earings turned black after a few days wearing. Have to return it.

reviews.title: Perfect 6mm sterling silver earrings!
reviews.text: Real sterling silver this earrings are just perfect for me. I love them and this is my everyday earrings. I ordered 6mm they are small but I like it like that! I will be ordering one size larger too. But I definitely recommend them to anyone, great price and great quality!

reviews.title: 6mm basic stud
reviews.text:
Basic stud earrings that look identical to website photo.

I purchased the 6mm (see photos) and they are lightweight and comfortable to wear. The post seems longer than average, so I wouldn't recommend for a child or to sleep in (I'm a side-sleeper so would poke me).

reviews.title: Poor Quality
reviews.text: These are not sterling silver earrings. The "silver" began to peel off after just a few wears.

reviews.title: Would not buy again
reviews.text: Earrings arrived promptly and I put them in my ears and left them on 24/7 for 2 weeks. They look good, like real silver. I doubt they are real though since the posts turned black and infected my ears. I threw them out.

reviews.title: Sterling Silver????
reviews.text: I got these for a crazy busy period where I won't have time to think about earrings. Just put them in and leave them....only my ears started to hurt and turn reddish after two days of wearing these (in multiple sizes). I have to wear sterling silver or gold-allergic to other things. These can't be sterling silver.

reviews.title: Inaccurate item description.
reviews.text: The item we received was 100% made of plastic and not sterling silver like the description says. The return/refund process was incredibly easy, we didn't even have to send them back to get a refund. But nevertheless, the item we received was not the item described in this listing.

reviews.title: Shiny!
reviews.text: I bought these 6mm Earrings as part of a Lightning Deal. For the price paid, they are quite nice- lightweight, shiny and look cute. They came nicely packaged in a small black box- which can be used for gifting. I like that they come in a variety of sizes. Overall, I am happy with these for now.

reviews.title: Cute Pendant, Thin Chain
reviews.text: The shipping of this product was super fast and it arrived in time for Christmas. However,the chain is extremely thin, making the pendant look cheap. I purchased a $20 sterling silver chain that was much thicker from a kiosk at the mall. Now, the pendant looks beautiful, elegant, and expensive. If you want to go through the hassle of purchasing a chain in addition to the pendant, this product may be worth your time. However, I would have preferred purchasing an item that was completely satisfactory upon receipt.

reviews.title: Apparently the stones are natural and undyed.
reviews.text:
I bought two. The first one came and was a beautiful deep crimson -- so sparkly. So I ordered a second for one daughter-in-law. But it was more of a brownish color and I was disappointed. Funny thing is, that is exactly what made her love it! The variation in the stones leads me to believe they are natural and not dyed.

This piece is very attractive on, and quite unique.

reviews.title: Sandymn
reviews.text: I bought this for my daughter whose birthday is in January -- garnet is the birthstone for that month. She is VERY particular about her jewelry. She loved the necklace! The stones were just the right size. The color of the stones were beautiful and the swirl between each stone set them off nicely.

reviews.title: Pretty, Worth the Price
reviews.text:
The pendant is very nice for the price. The stones at the top and bottom are a very pretty rich red, but the second stone from the bottom is almost orange. I expected some variation in color from natural stones, and the fact that they're natural is one of the reasons I bought this necklace, but I have to admit I wouldn't have purchased this particular pendant if I'd seen it in the store. Thankfully it's not exceptionally noticeable from a distance, so it's acceptable.
I also expected the pendant to be one fixed piece from the picture, but each garnet setting is an individual piece 'linked' to the others, so it bends slightly when it swings or dangles. It's not what I expected, but it's a nice effect with the dangling earrings I bought to match. The only downside to this is that it's possible that if it's bent too far one or more of the garnet settings will snap off.
The chain is, as mentioned in other reviews, thin and flimsy, but I knew that from the other reviews and purchased a stronger chain to put it on without too much extra expense. Overall, it's pretty, and considering the price I think it's well worth it.

reviews.title: Lovely little pendant
reviews.text:
My bridesmaids were all wearing lovely garnet red dresses and I wanted something to tie in with the color theme. Enter this lovely little pendant. The garnets are a lovely dark red color and the pendant is beautiful without being too over- or understated. Even though I didn't end up wearing it on my wedding day, I decided to keep it for everyday wear. It is the perfect accompaniment to dress up t-shirts or dresses. I'd definitely recommend it.

(I don't wear the 18" chain as I prefer a shorter chain, so my reveiw is only for the prendant)

reviews.title: Pretty and Delicate Necklace
reviews.text: Pretty and delicate little necklace. I am thinking of placing the pendant on one of my own silver chains, as it can be a challenge for me to do the tiny clasp on my own. My delivery was late, as the carrier had issues delivering the necklace to me directly. I contacted the carrier to rectify the issue, as my Amazon account said that I had received the order. When I did receive the necklace, it was in good shape, and appeared as described. I was able to wear the necklace to an event as I had originally planned.

reviews.title: BEAUTIFUL!
reviews.text: This necklace is absolutely beautiful! My girlfriend loved it when i gave it to her!

reviews.title: One Star
reviews.text: Smaller than I expected. Stones were not true garnet colored.

reviews.title: Perfect
reviews.text: Just the right size pendant and as sparkly as a real diamond for a fraction of the cost. The necklace itself is good quality and much better then any other necklace I've purchased online and the cz looks like some real diamonds I own and throws little rainbows everywhere. Such a simple, well made, realistic piece I hope to enjoy for years to come.

reviews.title: Nice necklace
reviews.text: Beautiful necklace with lots of sparkle and fire. The wife loved it.

reviews.title: Love the pendant.
reviews.text:
The pendant is extremely nice and looks like the real thing. The chain is just fine for that special night out but for daily wear you might want it put it on a stonger chain. The bale is big enough to put a thicker stronger chain which was a special added feature since most pendants certainly at this price point do not offer this feature.

Absolutely well worth the price and then some. I would give this as a gift and be to do so.

reviews.title: It's nothing special
reviews.text: I bought this necklace when it was one of Amazon's special deals of the day. It's okay for the $12.99 I spent on it but I wouldn't pay the full price for it. I was hoping to give it as a gift to my sister-in-law but I think I'll hold on to it. It will make a better gift for a teenager or young girl when I need one than for an adult woman.

reviews.title: Great find!
reviews.text:
Ok, seriously? This necklace, in my opinion, is perfect. And how much did I pay? Not much. If it doesn't tarnish over time I'll be super impressed.
I wear a lot of v-neck shirts and wanted silver, simple, but also noticeable. This is it! It was packaged nice and didn't have any tangles.

reviews.title: Looks authentic!
reviews.text: I love this necklace and I wear it almost everyday. It's beautiful and it looks so real! Go ahead buy it, it's worth the money!

reviews.title: Beautiful stone, with lots of sparkle
reviews.text: Beautiful stone, with lots of sparkle. Size is believable as well. The only reason I didnt give it 5 starts was although the chain it comes on looks and matches the stone, the clasp is adjustable which then gives it the fake look. I kept the stone and just changed out necklaces.

reviews.title: Better than the real thing!
reviews.text: Sure, if you're going to put it under a microscope, you can tell the difference. But from any other distance, this is wonderful! I have the coolest wife ever, too, because she loves it for the sparkle and for the wisdom of not spending $20,000!

reviews.title: Beautiful!!!
reviews.text: I bought this necklace to replace the necklace that came with my 2ct Swarovski Cubic Zirconia. I'm so glad I did, this necklace is beautiful. It shines and sparkles, it has a good weight to it and fits my pendant perfectly.

reviews.title: Great quality, Great price, Great necklace!
reviews.text: The quality of this necklace cannot be over stated. I got my wife a locket with pictures of us at our wedding inside, so she wears it every day. Over the past few months she has gone through three $50+ chains. I decided to find one that looked like it was of good quality. When it arrived, I inspected it closely and it looks as though it is made of three chains woven into one, and it feels very strong. I would recommend this product to anyone who is looking for a beautiful chain with superior quality.

reviews.title: Trust the words of a PICKY PRINCESS
reviews.text:
I'll be honest I'm a very picky person, this is the third sterling silver chain I've purchased from amazon, and before that I ordered 2 from theMjewlers (spent about 100 for those two) ,
This by far is the BEST chain I could have purchased. I wear it every day and only take it off when I shower just incase,
 however after I'd say after 3 months or so it still looks brand new! I sleep in it, doesn't make my skin darker or green, and only I take it off during my shower but I've also purchased a bracelet from this seller and I never take it off and so far still looks brand new aswell and that one definitely in the shower so who knows about the necklace. Either way this is after 3 months of use and from someone who looks high and low for a good quality chain, personally I don't buy without reading the reviews and if you're picky like me then maybe this will help! This is affordable, durable, beautiful and most of all reliable!

reviews.title: Great chain, I cold not be happier with it.
reviews.text:
I purchased this to go with some pendants purchased from Amazon hoping it would be a longer, more solid chain that looked better than the standard chains that you see. I got this as a gift for my wife, and it was well worth getting this chain! Very solid and looks great, I looked locally for chains before getting this one and I cannot believe what a good deal this is compared to what I saw in stores.

Well worth it, I am very pleased and my wife loves it!

reviews.title: I don't belive it's 100% sterling silver
reviews.text: It turned my neck green, I googled the problem and says that the necklace is either just plated or mixed with nickel. It is bright and shiney and seems strong so if you don't mind a green circle around your neck you're good.

reviews.title: Not at all what I bought
reviews.text: I bought two chains - a 36' and a 20'. The 36' was true to size, but the 20' was super tiny and short - not even 18'. It was way less than half the size of the 36'. Won't even go around my neck. Both chains are very light and "cheapy"

reviews.title: Very disappointed...
reviews.text: I took this necklace to my jeweler to fix a broken clasp and I was told that it is NOT sterling silver. It is plated at best. I'm very disappointed because this was a gift. I will be returning it immediately.

reviews.title: Look no further for an honest review!
reviews.text: Before you go and think this is some not created to give five stars on a product, let me tell you that I am in fact a human being. This necklace was very inexpensive for the quality of the product. It is a good length, easily long enough to fit the size of any lucky lady in your life yet not big enough to be uncomfortable. The light shines on it to give it a beautiful and vibrant shine that will certainly catch the eye of many. The quality of the product also is above the usual for products listed at this price, and I was overall very pleased with this item. I will be giving it to my dearest on Valentine's Day.

reviews.title: Besutiful anklet - very happy
reviews.text: The anklet fits perfectly. It's very shiny, chain is just thick enough (doesn't look like dental floss - it sparkles like it may be diamond cut). I also noticed that the anklet has 5 beads, rather than 4 as pictured - I like it better with the 5 beads. The spring ring clasp looks cheap but it's not that big a deal. I would be tempted to buy this in a bracelet length if I could find it. I would recommend it. Only negative is they dropped the price after I ordered and received the item!

reviews.title: This anklet tarnished within the first week of wearing it....
reviews.text:
I purchased this anklet last month. When I received it I was impressed with how shiny it was. It's well made and fit perfect.
Now for the downside....after about a week of wearing it, the entire anklet turned a blackish-brown color (tarnished). I have
tried using tarnish remover for sterling silver and well as polish for sterling silver. Nothing works. I have many other anklets
and I have never encountered this problem. The most frustrating issue is that Amazon won't take it back because I have had
it a couple of weeks past the return deadline. Unfortunately I was unaware of the discoloration problem right away because at
the time I purchased this anklet because the weather was still cold and I only wear my anklets in warm weather when I can wear
capris and long skirts.
I am usually very pleased with my purchases from Amazon but, this time ladies, I have to say don't waste your money!!

reviews.title: gorgeous
reviews.text:
Beautiful bright silver. Comfortable, ( I sleep with it on). Exceeded expectations. I absolutely Love it!!
I highly recommend this ankle bracelet.

reviews.title: Been looking for 1 for a long time
reviews.text: I never thought to order anklets on Amazon until a friend told me she ordered this same one and it was to small. I can never find one small enough for my ankles. All the mall ones are to big.

reviews.title: a little small
reviews.text: I'm a Professional Ankle Bracelet wearer. Although the bracelet is beautiful, it is a little snug on the ankle.. I would have preferred it be a 9.5 but its still pretty..

reviews.title: Sterling Sliver Singapore with 4mm Bead Stations Chain Anklet, 9"
reviews.text:
I really like the design and comfortable wear of the Anklet. It has retained its shine through my daily wear.

I do find the clasp difficult to manage though.

reviews.title: Finally, a Sterling silver anklet for wider ankles!
reviews.text: I love this Sterling Silver Anklet. It is 9 inches long. I put it on my ankle 2 weeks ago and I haven't taken it off yet. I might add a dangling heart or Dragonfly charm to hang from the center. But it looks just as pretty with just the 6 silver beads all the way around it. As I say in my house, a "What's good for me is good for thee😉"

reviews.title: Beautiful...but shorter than 9"
reviews.text: I have small ankles but could not even get this to close. I measured the length with a ruler and it is shorter than the stated 9". I will see if a jeweler can add an additional link; if not, it will need to be returned.

reviews.title: Lovely, light and eyecatching
reviews.text: This lovely cross is just fancy enough to attract attention, without being too frilly for everyday wear. The craftsmanship is superb, it's solid without being heavy and substantial without you constantly noticing it. The edges are finished smoothly; it does not hang up on or snag my clothing nor tangle in my long hair. It's a lovely everyday pieced dressed up a bit, but well worth the money.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: I purchased this for my daughter which is 28 years old - I was not sure if she would like it or not but I loved it. When she opened it she put it on and it looked great with the other necklaces she had on. She fell in love with it and has yet to take it off.

reviews.title: Beautiful necklace for great price!
reviews.text: Absolutely LOVE this necklace! It is a great length and perfect size pendant. The design of the cross is beautiful. Pictures cannot do it justice. The price on this is even better!

reviews.title: While the pendant itself is beautiful and a good quality
reviews.text:
While the pendant itself is beautiful and a good quality, the necklace arrived tossed carelessly into a box with no packaging or cotton, and the chain was snarled into a knotted mess about the size of a jelly bean. After a half an hour of trying, I was unsuccessful in fixing it.
I had paid for overnight shipping so that I could give it as a gift, and now I cannot. Very frustrating.

reviews.title: Pretty, but...
reviews.text:
This cross is pretty. It's hollow on the back though. Disregard what a previous poster said about the photo being a picture of the backside - it's NOT. This item was made in China, and although it's nice, I wouldn't have bought a cross from China had I known. Stamp says 'S 925', meaning it's Sterling silver, but it's rather lightweight, as is the rolo chain. It's fine for me because i'm not rough on my personal things. The cross is a good size (over an inch tall, NOT including the eye/bail), but the 18" long chain is too long for me (i'm petite). Unless i'm wearing a low v-neck top the cross is atop or under my shirt.
Someone else complained that there's arrived tarnished - mine is so shiny that I question whether it's real sterling silver. It arrived in a black velvet bag with a box as well.

reviews.title: Did not keep its shine
reviews.text: Beautiful pendant; however it tarnished very quickly and not looks more black than silver.

reviews.title: It is quite beautiful for the price and is marked with the 925 ...
reviews.text: The cross arrived today on Holy Saturday even though I ordered it last Wednesday, April 12. It is quite beautiful for the price and is marked with the 925 for oxidized sterling. The cross itself is sturdy and not thin but very feminine. The chain, too, is feminine and dainty -- not too thick for the pendant but sturdy enough. I checked all the jump rings on it, and they were well closed. I would not recommend sleeping with the necklace on, but then I always take my necklaces off when sleeping as twisting and turning in ones sleep will eventually break almost any chain. It pulls on the jump rings and quite often opens them and off comes the pendant.

reviews.title: traditional elegance
reviews.text: Some designs just can't be improved with time. I looked at others and this tradional style struck me with its solid flowing lines. I took a chance that my daughter would agree and she loved it. It is a little heavier than most and feels substantial.

reviews.title: Sort of dissapointed
reviews.text: Th piece it's self is nice, it's about the size of a quarter, however there is a "made in China" stamped in the back and the chain seems somewhat flimsy. Upon opening it the chain knotted up which I'm still having trouble with.

reviews.title: Gorgeous pendant; needs different chain
reviews.text: This is a beautiful silver pendant -- striking and substantial. Sadly the chain it comes with is too flimsy and in my opinion, too short for such a piece. The pendant needs a longer, more substantial chain. Thanks to Amazon Curated Collection's free returns policy, I was able to try a couple, and found the perfect chain: Sterling Silver 1.8mm 22" Figaro Chain. MADE IN ITALY ($15.26) The figaro design, longer length, and 1.8 mm width makes the chain perfect for this pendant. By the way, the stated pendant measurements are confusing, with height including the bale. It's really a perfect circle, one inch in diameter.

reviews.title: Bait and switch
reviews.text:
When I ordered the necklace it was supposed to be from Diamond Mountain The necklace normally comes in a beautiful box and is protected in plastic and a cushioned case and had a cleaning cloth for $30.
The one you sent from plain Amazon for the same $30 is a very inferior product. Unfortunately I have to keep it as it was a gift from a friend and she doesn't know that I lost the first one she sent from Amazon.

This necklace you sent to me was thrown in the bottom of a cheap hard to open box all by itself no protection just tangled in the bottom.
I went on line and saw that Diamond Mountain was crossed out with a red line and two days later it just said Amazon necklace. The quality was no where near the quality of the first one I received as a gift through Amazon from Diamond Mountain.. The chain is cheap hard to put on and won't last long.You can't advertise one thing and then switch it with one of yours before it is sent. That's not fair. It's
 definitely not worth $30. Iwill buy a new chain but even the quality of the pendant is not the same.
I would think twice if I were Amazon and was going to fool people....everyone isn't as dumb as you think but probably won't complain…

reviews.title: Not good for some clasps...
reviews.text: I like the look and size of the pendant, it seems to be made well, but I haven't worn it yet. I wish the loop where the pendant hangs on a chain/cord was bigger. I bought this to put on a 2mm leather necklace, but couldn't get the clasp through the loop. I'd have to find something with a smaller clasp, or make a necklace and put the pendant on the leather cord without the clasps, then add the clasps just to get it on. Then again, maybe I need to criticize the size of the clasp on the leather necklace I bought for being too big, lol. Other than that, it's a nice pendant, just something to consider when ordering....maybe include dimensions of the loop opening in the description of the pendant? The silver chain in the picture is what comes with the pendant, the leather one is the 2mm I purchased on Amazon. I had to take the end hoop off of the leather necklace, put the pendant on, and replace the hoop.

reviews.title: She likes it.
reviews.text:
I'm not in love with the piece, but it went over great with her.

This is a solid piece not some of the more cheaply made stuff you find for only a little cheaper. It was made by stamping it from a sheet of silver. It comes in one of the nicest boxes I've seen short of an expensive engagement ring. Otherwise I can't complain.

reviews.title: Nice
reviews.text: This is a nice, well made pendant. It is a little bigger than I expected - I should have paid more attention to the details. I like a lot of the jewelry in the Curated Collection and I thought I'd start with something inexpensive to see what kind of quality to expect. The chain is nice, but maybe too delicate for the heaviness of the pendant. I have been wearing it a lot and get compliments.

reviews.title: Quality Cut-Out
reviews.text: I love the Amazon Collection, and I know it's of good quality, but the pendent really resembles a cookie cut-out more than a piece of fine jewelry. It's light, shiny, and seems as if it could withstand the rigors of day-to-day living, and considering the material quality, it is still a bargain. Just don't expect miracles.

reviews.title: I'm 'knot' disappointed!
reviews.text: This was an impulse purchase, but I have been looking for a nice piece of celtic jewelry at a reasonable price for quite some time. The necklace shipped shortly after I placed the order and it is much more substantial than I thought it would be. I have received several compliments and am thinking about buying another design and perhaps the matching earrings. I have even told a few friends about the Celtic knot jewelry on Amazon so more orders may be placed soon~

reviews.title: Singing It's Praises
reviews.text: WE loved this necklace. I purchased it as a back-to-school gift for my stepdaughter who is in the chorus. She LOVED this necklace. It has a beautiful shine, I love the chain and kind of wish I bought one for myself (I used to play piano). The treble charm was a nice size and so very shiny on a dainty but substantial chain. It came in a nice black box, displayed on a black velvet sleeve, and the inside of the box lid was a beautiful blue. A very nice presentation as a gift. I would totally recommend this necklace for any music lover. I seriously may buy one for myself, not just for the music note but for the chain that I could use for other charms. Bravo.

reviews.title: Cute but a little not sure how long it will last
reviews.text: It's really pretty, but it's very light weight. I'm not sure how solid it is and I don't intend to wear it in the shower or anything. I put it on a different chain because the one it came with seemed like it would break. I'm going to give it a decent rating for now because it it very nice looking and hopefully it will stay that way for a while. Also, it's not actually a "musical note." It's a treble clef. Just saying.

reviews.title: not happy. Will be surprised if this will elicit any ...
reviews.text: The necklace is lovely, however, the description said it would be engraved with a message. It was not. When I contacted Amazon the response was, "how this will help future customers". I was really hoping for a more pro-active response. Necklace, just okay - Amazon, not happy. Will be surprised if this will elicit any further response from Amazon.

reviews.title: Simple yet elegant necklace
reviews.text: I bought this for my sister who's in orchestra and she adores it. The necklace is elegant yet simple. The pendant is the perfect size because it doesn't scream "LOOK AT ME!!" yet it's noticeable. With it being sterling silver it contrasts very well with her black orchestra dress, but I thought it also looked cute when she wore jeans and a hoodie. I was also surprised by the quality because the price was under $20. I definitely recommend this necklace to any music enthusiast!!

reviews.title: Very beautiful
reviews.text: Bought this for my 10 yr old daughter who excels at piano. She loves it and wears it all the time.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: I bought this for my daughter for Christmas. She loves it. It's smaller than I expected but can still clearly tell what it is while she's wearing it. The chain is thin and I'll likely be replacing that but for the price, you can't go wrong.

reviews.title: Lovely Christmas gift
reviews.text: I received this necklace as a gift from a friend who found it on my wishlist. I think it's beautiful and the pendant is a good size. Have not had any issues with the chain.

reviews.title: Conveys a Subtle Musical Message
reviews.text: A quality piece of jewetry that conveys a subtle musical message that my grand daughter radiates-her love for all music.

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: From the picture, I was really looking forward to these earrings. I did not read the description carefully enough, it is as tall and as wide as I expected, but they are much thicker than I anticipated, 1/4 inch, which gives them more weight than I like to wear. I also must not have been thinking, because of course no two flowers are exactly alike, so of course mine will not look like the ones in the picture, but my middle flower is yellow, there is no hint of orange too it, and the surrounding little flowers are more brown than orange. It is just not pretty at all, and the one in the picture is so beautiful. I will not purchase earrings online again, as I would want to look at all the options and pick the nicest, not get the bottom of the box pair mailed to me. So, a disappointing purchase, not worth it at all.

reviews.title: The earrings are great all around
reviews.text:
The earrings are great all around. I'm very satisfied with the product.

On the processing end though, there was a hiccup with the order - for some reason, the item came with a mother's day message from "Nick and Sam." I bought these earrings for my girlfriend and did not include a message. So it seems like there was a mixup by Amazon. I didn't take any stars off - although I would like to take half a star for this processing mixup. It is unfortunate that the message from Nick and Sam may not make it to their mom. Amazon please pay extra attention when fulfilling these orders - some of us put a lot of time and effort into these little gift messages and it's a shame if more of these messages are not making it to their intended recipients.

reviews.title: These earrings are precious!
reviews.text: I have these earrings and they are precious! I cannot wear big or heavy earrings at all. These I can; hence this review. Very pleased!

reviews.title: beautiful
reviews.text: bought it on the lightning deal but was disappointed when the price came through at the normal level. Dealt with customer service and hope to NEVER deal with them again on another matter. It wasn't worth the time and aggravation for seven dollars. The earrings are worth $29.00 easily. Haven't worn them yet because it is the holidays and I wear holiday earrings every day. If you love flowers and jewelry you will be delighted with the color and the quality.

reviews.title: Perfect
reviews.text: I was really surprised at how gorgeous these actually were in person. I got these for my mother-in-law and she loves them. They look expensive. The workmanship is excellent.

reviews.title: Two Stars
reviews.text: The large flower on one of the earrings is not yellow. It looks defected.

reviews.title: Beautiful Earrings are Yellow, not Orange
reviews.text: While these were described as orange and they look orange, the pair I got is yellow, but that's okay, b/c I needed a pair of yellow earrings anyway and had given up on finding a beautiful pair of yellow earrings. These are it! They are gorgeous and go beautifully with my yellow outfits. Perhaps it's just the variation in the color of the flowers that are used or the color as it shows on the computer, but I didn't find them to be orange at all. There's also green in them. All in all, they'd make a beautiful gift, but I would not count on them being orange as shown.

reviews.title: The earrings that jazz up any outfit!!
reviews.text: Ok, I'm not one to write reviews but I can not just let any of y'all out there walk past these without giving them a shot! I have sensitive ears and I have not run into a problem with these, no irritations or anything. They are on the lighter side, not as light as studs but nothing like big hoops. If you have any ounce of an earthy spirit, give these a try! Personal note: I enjoy feeling my earrings jingle so I like that they aren't the lightest but if you like light earrings you may not be a fan!

reviews.title: Cute but Tiny
reviews.text: Bought this as a birthday gift. The details are gorgeous, but the pendant is too tiny at less than an inch wide and hence barely noticed when worn.

reviews.title: Very Pretty!
reviews.text:
I bought this necklace in March 2012, and have really enjoyed wearing it. It has made me feel like I've wearing a little bouquet of spring wildflowers, and the vibrant colors remind me of the Texas Hill Country, which is very beautiful.

The necklace is good quality. The heart is about the size of a man's thumbnail, so it's big enough you can see it, but small enough to be feminine. The flowers themselves are very tiny, but very detailed, and they are laid out perfectly. The flowers "pop" when worn over a light-colored sweater or blouse.

This isn't an expensive necklace, but it's good enough quality it can be worn in a professional work environment.

reviews.title: Beautiful for a little girl
reviews.text: I read the other reviews before purchasing this necklace. Based on what they wrote, I ordered this as a gift for a child. It's perfect for a little girl, and is very pretty. I would not recommend it for an adult woman, unless she is very small.

reviews.title: Love it! Chain is 16'
reviews.text: So cute. Love it! Chain is 16', but I don't mind.

reviews.title: Good deposit for the marriage bank
reviews.text: My wife really liked this pendant. I got her the matching earrings a month ago, and they look great together.

reviews.title: Intrinsic Beauty
reviews.text:
What could be more beautiful than nature? I gave this as a gift, and it has held up over a year; by held up I mean the flowers' colors have NOT faded, the clear material the flowers are in has not yellowed, and the surface has resisted scratching.

This is pretty well made! IT does not feel/look cheap, no signs of excess trim from casting, and everyone is unique. The $25 i paid is well worth it.

reviews.title: One Star
reviews.text: Very small and when my wife wore it for the first time, it left her skin red and irritated.

reviews.title: Pretty
reviews.text: This was a gift and the recipient was very pleased. I too thought it was pretty however, the picture shows the backround to be white and the one I received was more clear. Nevertheless, it's still quite pretty and dainty and for the money certainly a value.

reviews.title: Beautiful Necklace and a Beautiful Gift!
reviews.text:
I bought this beautiful necklace (along with the matching earrings) as a gift for my sister-in-law. I was a little hesitant before I actually made the Amazon purchase as I have had some bad experience with pressed-flowers-jewelry. Sometimes one gets a product where the flowers are so crushed or petals are missing that the piece just isn't attractive. In this case, I could not have been more pleased at the quality of the necklace or of the pair of matching earrings I purchased! The necklace actually looks better than the picture on the Amazon page. The little flowers at the bottom of the pendant are very delicate, and all the petals are 'on' each flower head. The larger flower on my pendant floats above the smaller flowers and is separate from them.

I highly recommend this necklace (and look for the matching earrings!) My sister-in-law (the professional artist) also gives her thumbs up!

reviews.title: Beautiful,tiny, delicate, colorful!
reviews.text: I helped my teenage son buy this for his 17 year old girlfriend. I have to say I was a little nervous about the quality while we waited for it to arrive. I was worried it would look like plastic, or have rough edges or be too small & I didn't think it could possibly be as colorful & pretty as the picture. I was wrong. It was beautiful, just as colorful as the picture. The resin was smooth & clear, no rough spots. I was worried because others said the chain was short, but the person who received it is small & delicate herself & the chain was perfect on her. This is a small, delicate necklace - be sure you understand that so you aren't disappointed. I wish I'd measured the length, but I forgot. The order page says it 1/2" wide & it is - look at a ruler or tape measure, 1/2" is tiny. That doesn't mean it's bad, I loved the necklace the way it is. I just wanted to be clear about the size because too many people order things without REALLY paying attention to the size, then give it a lower rating because of it.

reviews.title: Pretty pendant, but....
reviews.text: While the pendant is very pretty and sized for an adult, the chain is so short that I couldn't do it up. I'm not overly large. A normal 16" or 18" chain with a pendant puts the pendant just below the dip in my collar bone. This chain is so short that it chokes me. I plan to keep the pendant, but I'll replace the chain so I can wear it. The pendant is really pretty and the little flowers in it are so bright. Just wish the chain was usable. If the chain was long enough, I'd give this 5 stars!

reviews.title: Very delicate and beautiful
reviews.text: This is a beautiful necklace, very delicate, very feminine. Makes a very subtle statement of simplicity with taste. It is small in size so if you are looking for a dynamic pendant, this isn't it. I am delighted with it.

reviews.title: Nice necklace, but disappointed that it did not come ...
reviews.text: Nice necklace, but disappointed that it did not come in a box as advertised.... I bought this as a gift, it's tacky to gift a necklace in a plastic bag....

reviews.title: better suited for a child than an adult
reviews.text: Was much smaller in actuality and the flowers not as bright as in the picture. I was planning to give it to an elderly lady and decided to order something else instead, and to give this necklace to my 10 year old niece. It seemed more appropriate for a younger person.

reviews.title: chain too small
reviews.text: The pendant is very nice but the chain is useless. Too small. Better to sell the pendant alone or include an 18/20 inch chain

reviews.title: Smaller than I expected but still pretty
reviews.text:
The teardrop necklace is smaller than I thought it would be but very pretty. The teardrop is about an inch long at most.
The chain that it came with is really small and I will definitely need to purchase a new chain for it before I gift it to my friend but the pressed flowers in the teardrop shape is beautiful. The chain is nearly a choker chain.
Shipping: the envelope it came in was not damaged. The jewelry box it came in was nice but missing the foam that would bring the necklace to the top of the box rather than the very bottom of the box. Kinda lowers the quality look of the jewelry.

reviews.title: Friendship necklace
reviews.text: I wanted to purchase a sentimental gift for my best friend for Christmas. I bought this necklace because of the sweet message on it. I received my package earlier than expected and found it to be very pretty and dainty. The words are small but easy to read and the silver was very shiny. It had a gleam in the sunlight. I will definitely buy from this supplier again.

reviews.title: Friendship necklace
reviews.text: My friend loves it. She was having a difficult surgery done and cried when she got this. It made her feel better knowing someone cared even though I couldn't be there at the time. I am so glad I got it for her.

reviews.title: Misspelled
reviews.text: I notice in the picture that the message in the back has an unneeded apostrophe. (I' am)

reviews.title: Maid of Honor Gift
reviews.text: I bought this for my maid of honor. She loved it! It is beautiful and well made. Although I do have to agree with the other reviews--they messed up the back of it and added an extra apostrophe. Oh well she didn't notice and it is beautiful. I would definitely purchase this item again.

reviews.title: typo on item
reviews.text: The pendant is beautiful and delicate, but there is a typo on one side. The description reads "I am a Better Me because of You". However, the actual print on the pendant is "I' am a better Me because of you". Once I received the item, I looked closely at the photos and sure enough, the typo is actually on the pictures, as well, but I ordered based on what what written in the description. I can only hope that it is small enough that people won't really notice?

reviews.title: Necklace
reviews.text: I love this necklace. The chain is very sturdy also. I usually break them right away and this one has stood up

reviews.title: Necklace broke 5 minutes after putting it on
reviews.text:
I bought this necklace for a very special friend of mine. I put it on her and it looked great. The necklace is very thin and skinny, so I knew I had to be careful. The pendent is very charming as well, albeit small. After putting it on, she turned the necklace so its straight and it just broke off!

I was highly upset by this because not only did it make me look bad, but also very cheap. It reflects very poorly, and it was her trying to comfort me that she can always buy another chain and put the pendent on that.

If you do buy this, buy it for the pendent. There is no reliance on the chain, it will break very easily.

The packaging was very good though, it makes it look higher quality.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: I wanted something special for my bestie for christmas. The necklace arrived early, she loved it! It was so beautiful it made her cry. It was much prettier than pictured. The engraving is beautifully done and the pendant is small and dainty. Highly reccomended if you want a gift for your special friend.

reviews.title: being a smart man, saw them on my wish list and ...
reviews.text:
I received these earrings as a gift from my fiance after I put them on my wish list. He, being a smart man, saw them on my wish list and ordered them for me as a surprise. They're gorgeous, even prettier than they look in the picture. The amethysts are a bit darker purple than they are in the picture, a very nice shade. I don't have pierced ears but I was able to convert them to clip-on earrings and they looked great. They feel solidly made but they're not heavy, a definite plus.

I'm going to try to post a picture but it looks like it will be sideways--we'll see. At any rate, you'll be able to see how they looked on me.

reviews.title: Great for the price!
reviews.text:
Great pair of 925 Sterling Silver earrings with a slight weight to them. Not too heavy. Impressive packaging to give as a gift. The earrings came in a plastic bag inside the gift box, so make sure you take them out and hook them on the earring holder.
I took a picture especially showing the “flatness” of the earrings another review wrote about. I think they are perfectly fine. No one looks at the back of your earrings. Note that these WILL fall out of your ears. You will need a stopper for the ‘fish hook’ which is not included.

reviews.title: Worth the price, perfect for my outfit!
reviews.text: These are lovely! The purple stone is a nice size and reflects color beautifully. The drop is about an inch, understated but eye catching. They arrived in a box, well secured in side. I'm very pleased with this purchase.

reviews.title: Silver Celtic Knot Amethyst
reviews.text: I gave a 4 not 5, because they are flat. Not quite sure how else to say it, physically flat. I think I was expecting something a bit more 3D from the pictures. To me it looks like the silver scroll work would be layered and it doesn't feel that way. They are beautiful and I love them. But I am a purple freak, give me purple and I am happy, just not sure that had I been able to touch them before I purchased that I would have gotten them. They do look lovely on, have gotten lots of compliments on them.

reviews.title: Photo Misleading
reviews.text: These earrings are tiny, cheap looking and more suited for a doll than a human. A gift for my wife, I was embarrassed when she opened the package. The photo is most misleading.

reviews.title: Cheap Looking
reviews.text:
Very disappointed in these earrings. I have sent them back as they look so cheap that they look like
they came from a kids toy machine. I would be embatassed to wear them.

reviews.title: Nice and Dainty Amethyst Earrings
reviews.text: The earrings are dainty and hang nice. The amethyst is of good color. I would definitely buy another with another gemstone in it.

reviews.title: Earrings💕
reviews.text: They are beautiful, I just can't keep them in my ears. They flew out more than once at work. Might need to get backs.

reviews.title: Love it!
reviews.text: I was actually surprised at how much I love this bracelet! It's very well made. With link bracelets I've had in the passed they've felt light and cheapy, like if they were to get caught on anything they'd break, and this one is just the opposite. It's shiny, heavy and sturdy, I've been able to hang several charms on it with no worries of it breaking on me. Do take extra note that it is only 7", it's very small, which is PERFECT for me because my wrists are small, and so it doesn't dangle obnoxiously on me like most bracelets do. Yet it's loose enough to hang charms on comfortably. I also love the round links! It makes it unique and extra charming, hehe. Anyway, bottom line, I love it. It's so perfect, at least for me.

reviews.title: perfect
reviews.text: The bracelet is very pretty - the links are round, and that makes the bracelet slide up and down the wrist easily. It is 7" length, so it is perfect if you have a slender wrist. All in all, a wonderful bracelet - and you can clip charms on it!!

reviews.title: Lovely Charm Bracelet
reviews.text: These charm bracelets are very nice. I wanted them for my nieces who are very young. The links are thick and seem very sturdy. Make sure you only need a 7" length (it's pretty small). The one complaint I have is that I ordered them at the same time, got them together in the same shipping - and they were in two totally different sized boxes and "jewelry bags"...which makes it odd when I am giving them to sisters on Christmas.

reviews.title: very small
reviews.text: it is definitely not 7" and its too bad because it was really nice and made well.

reviews.title: I love the bracelet
reviews.text: I love the bracelet. It fits my wrist perfectly. It's like the size was custom made, just for me. I hope it holds up. The price was definitely worth it. It looks very well made and I love the rollo style. It's great. I'm very pleased.

reviews.title: Absolutely love this bracelet
reviews.text: Absolutely love this bracelet. I wear it daily and never take it off (shower, sleep, work out in it) and it still looks amazing. I have probably been wearing it for 2-3 months straight (if not longer) and it has not yet tarnished. It is great quality, but be aware that it is only seven inches and will be tight on many wrists. My wrist is 6.25 inches and I could not imagine it fitting anyone well over 6.5 inches (despite it being a 7 inch bracelet).

reviews.title: Darling and sturdy
reviews.text: I liked the bracelet in the photo but I love the bracelet now that it arrived. It's highly polished, well made, and suitable for charms that have a large clasp or hoop. It is definitely for small wrists. This is the kind of bracelet you hardly notice is there but love having it on.

reviews.title: Great item!
reviews.text: I bought this for my mother and she loves it! She never takes it off, wears it everyday, and it looks just like when she got it. It is definitely worth the price, and I would recommend this to anyone. The bracelet is on the small side but it does fit the smaller wrist.

reviews.title: Marvelous Earrings
reviews.text: I bought these earrings to go with a hammered silver oval link necklace (also on Amazon) and they look sensational together! These came in a velvet divided jewelry bag---one earring in each side. They are not too long---just right for a sassy look with chin-length hair. Dainty and not heavy! I love them!

reviews.title: Nice, but will bend VERY easy....
reviews.text:
I bought these because of the great price point and the fact that they match a necklace I have perfectly.

They look nice and are very lightweight...I only have 2 "issues"...

ONE, the actual size or length of the hook is a lot longer than my other hook style earrings. I wear my hair up mostly, so don't like the fact that I can see so much of the hook.

TWO, they bend VERY easy... I actually bent one just taking the backing off and then again putting it on... this may be a pair that I don't use the backings because of this.

Overall a very nice pair of earrings for $10... can't beat it!

reviews.title: multi circle dangle earrings
reviews.text: These earrings were just awful when I received them. They look nothing like the picture in the description. The ones I received were so small and the circles were all tangled up as I tried to untangle them it just became worse I was afraid I'd break them as they were also fragile not sturdy at all. Thank goodness for amazon's return policy I returned them immediatly and they refunded my $14.98. Awful earrings but great return policy.

reviews.title: Delicate
reviews.text:
The first pair i received had a defect. Amazon promptly mailed a replacement and they're perfect.

The have French hooks (wish were lever back, but not a deal breaker - just a preference) and two circles per level.

Be sure to store with care. Don't toss in a jewelry box with other stuff. They are thin circles and I assume they will bend easy.

They look just like the picture and are well made and lightweight.

reviews.title: Super lightweight and attractive
reviews.text:
These are very attractive, lightweight earrings. The larger circles are about the diameter of a nickle. They are a good length to show below a shorter hair style, but are not long enough to get caught in clothing.
One of the earrings came with the bottom larger circle inserted through the middle one. It took a while to figure out how to unkink it, and I can't imagine how that happened. Amazon packaged these earrings and another pair I purchased in a manner equivalent to a nice jewelry store. They were placed in a lined, velvet pouch with each earring in its own side of the split storage pouch. The drawstring pouch was then placed into a cotton lined navy box. I was impressed.

reviews.title: Perfect for me
reviews.text: I find no flaw in these earrings. They were inexpensive. They are light and beautiful. I did not find the hooks to be too thick or too thin. There were no pieces to fall off of the hooks and none are needed. I am puzzled by reviews that say the earrings are fragile. My ears cannot take thick hooks; these earrings keep their shape and are perfect for me.

reviews.title: Good decision
reviews.text: I was thinking that the earrings might be looking too cheap, too light, maybe too long, but I really like them, they are light, so is easy to wear, are shinny in a way that u can tell is silver and I had a lot of compliments! I even wore them today at work, can go with everything and they look awesome. The thing is they can tangle, u just have to be careful how u store them.

reviews.title: Lovely earrings!
reviews.text: Beautiful earrings - nice and shiny and were well packaged. Have been wearing them since received and still loving them. I have a metal allergy and have had no issue with these earrings. Would certainly recommend.

reviews.title: Pretty
reviews.text:
These are of good quality, dangle nicely, and are just long enough so that they dangle just below my jaw line.
They're not too long or gawdy, which is a shame. I'm really loving the neck length earrings these days.
The 2.2 inch measurement includes the French wire, by the way. It would be great if amazon could clarify this in the listing.
I took one star off because they're not what I consider large. I can think of all sorts of clever jokes to follow that last statement, but I will leave it at that.

reviews.title: Do not buy!!! Run!!!
reviews.text: I have metal allergies so I tend to buy sterling silver and stainless steel jewelry only. I got these and upon arrival I noticed that they were not only smaller than I thought, but not stamped sterling silver. I got them July 1st and started wearing them July 4th. It is now July 9th and my ears are red and irritated. I take them out and the metal has changed color!!!! Run!! Do not buy!!!

reviews.title: Excellet!
reviews.text: These are beautiful and have a nice quality right down to the rings that separate each diamond shape. They are light and move nicely. The only con that seems to be the growing trend for dangling earrings in general, is the lack of back pieces. So you just have to be careful not to lose them. They have excellent quality especially for the price and would probably cost 2-3x as much in a dept store.

reviews.title: Short, quickly tarnished, not sterling silver.
reviews.text: Don't buy these! They're much smaller than expected. The diamond shapes and the entire earring looked more elongated in the picture than real life. Also, they might not be sterling silver! Note: I store them in the velvet baggy it came with and then inside the gift box inside my drawer, and yet, these earrings turned brown very quickly at the top and the bottom. I wish someone would have written this review before I plopped 30 bucks on this. Save your money on something worthy!

reviews.title: Pretty earrings to look at
reviews.text: Pretty earrings to look at, but these are not pure sterling silver. They must contain nickel or some other kind of metal.. while the fishhooks were fine, the dangling metal that rested on my neck when wearing these for just a few hours caused an awful contact rash that lasted over a week.

reviews.title: Not sterling silver
reviews.text: [[VIDEOID:ea45399752e5002b86c3af481f9ecfc2]] They are stamped on the post but i cant make it out. not sterling silver dk what it is silver plate or what but it sticks to magnet.

reviews.title: Cute, but small in person
reviews.text: When I saw these, I instantly liked the design. However, I expected them to be a bit longer. They are actually pretty small. I wished they were a little bigger so it's more noticeable.

reviews.title: Broke while putting on for second time!!
reviews.text:
The wire itself broke. Because it is an integral wire, it is not an easy fix :[
Was 2 days late to return/replace by second time I wore these (since they're fancy to me - not for my everyday use).

reviews.title: So very disappointed.
reviews.text: I bought 2 and they don't match the description or the description of other people's reviews. Perhaps they have changed their source. The "be" disc is substantially smaller than in the pic and has damage at the hole. Looking closely, different fonts than in the pic are used on the entire necklace. The pic also shows a nice smooth flat surface, the items have a definite stamped texture and are curved. The chain is also different. The whole thing looks like something I could have bought for under $5 at my local store. I've included the original photo with my two for easy comparison.

reviews.title: Great everyday necklace at a great price!
reviews.text: I've received so many compliments on this necklace! The length is perfect, the silver and rose gold make it super versatile, and the quality is better than what I was expecting. I was a little concerned about the size of the charm based on some of the other reviews, but I think it's perfect - not too big, not too small. The silver charm is almost the exact size of a dime, only slightly smaller. I'm planning on buying a couple more as gifts!

reviews.title: Soooo cute!!
reviews.text:
Got my necklace today and I am in love with it. I'm glad I ordered it- it would make a great gift as well....

The photo isn't great -but the necklace is! If I lay it on top of the dime you can barely see the ridges of the dime - almost exactly the same size.

reviews.title: What I Expected. Understated.. But lovely.
reviews.text: Love it! Live the message. It is the size expected- small. About the size of a dime. But, it is understated and I like that. It could be layered with other chains for a more dramatic look - if that is your issue with this piece. I have only worn it a few days, so not sure about the wear. The only issue I have is the clasp. It is difficult to feel when putting it on.

reviews.title: I like it but...
reviews.text: It is attractive enough when it arrives and I still like it, but there is already discoloration and I've only had it for a week and a half and have just worn it a handful of times. I don't wear it in the shower or at the gym, so I am disappointed with the appearance diminishing so rapidly. I had another of these and lost it while on vacation. The first one maintained its appearance longer.

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text:
I was looking forward to receiving this necklace but unfortunately the word "be" which was the purpose of the whole necklace was written as "he" as shown in the picture attached.
So i do not know what to do with it and demand to be sent a new one.

reviews.title: This is tiny
reviews.text: I may not have read the description well enough, but this is far smaller than I expected. I have to put on my magnifying glasses to read it. Not sure it is worth the money,

reviews.title: smaller than expected
reviews.text: But good quality. Still i is smaller than a dime, so if you a looking for a large pendant or something for an adult, you might not be interested.

reviews.title: I Got them Late - and Returned them Immediately
reviews.text: Two things you should know: 1) I bought these on mega-sale with the necklace. 2) It arrived very long after I was supposed to have gotten them. I hate to disagree with everyone here... they looked much like the picture, but were definitely not the fine quality I thought I was buying. Basically, on sale you are paying real retail for a low-quality item. I was very disappointed with the quality (of the necklace especially) and was not something I wanted to wear. CLEARLY many people on this site disagree. However, I wanted to be the lone dissenter in case anyone was unsure. It did not seem "fine" quality to me, although the design is gorgeous. The center stone is not one stone but 3 small squares, and the necklace chain looked like something you'd sell to a child. The earrings looked (literally) machine-folded together. Buy for the design, and ignore the false "bargain" of the markdown.

reviews.title: i returned them
reviews.text: i really like the art deco style, and these looked perfect. they are a nice size and style, but they did not look to me like $100 earrings. they did not have much shine or presence, not eye-catching. when i opened the package, i could tell at once they were just not for me so i returned them.

reviews.title: Absolutely beautiful!
reviews.text: We got these for my daughters wedding as a last minute emergency replacement for another pair that didn't work out. It was risky because we couldn't see them in person but they are lovely. While they are definitly brightly jeweled, they are not gaudy or over the top. She can wear these for a lifetime. This was money well spent.

reviews.title: I would never have given these as a gift
reviews.text: The earrings arrived with one being on the wire backwards and the other completely detached from the wire. I have tools, so I could easily fix the problem. The other thing is they are not "matched." The sapphire channel on one earring is noticibly narrower than the other. The gold around the diamonds is barely noticible, but then the earrings are really quite small. I paid $149, which when I saw them I thought was a little steep, but I am a sucker for art deco and they go with other sapphire art deco style jewelry I have, so I will go ahead and keep them. If I were in the market for a jewelry gift, I'd probably go to a store where I could see what I was getting. I would not recommend these for gift giving.

reviews.title: earrings
reviews.text: The backs are not sturdy, they move and are uneven. I liked them but like I said the back are not sturdy.

reviews.title: Sent right back. Cheaply made.
reviews.text: Very cheaply made. Not at all what I expected. Returned the next day. No wear is item marked sterling silver, gold or sapphires. Only marking in box and outside of box is Made in China.

reviews.title: What a surprise !
reviews.text: I was pleasantly surprise when I received these earrings. They're pretty and just the right size, even more beautiful than what is shown. (Thanks to the reviews) I bought them to wear to a wedding and received lots of compliments.

reviews.title: Cheap costume jewlery
reviews.text: Both earrings fell apart when I took them out of the box. Not worth $135. Only worth$1.35. Very cheaply made

reviews.title: Not American made
reviews.text: These earrings are beautiful. However, they are from China. The back clasp on one of them is extremely loose, still worth the money

reviews.title: I would highly recommend this purchase especially together with the necklace.
reviews.text: Bought the necklace at the same time and have already worn them. Feel so dressed up wearing the set. I have enjoyed wearing them and look forward to enjoying them many more times.

reviews.title: Cultured Pearl earrings
reviews.text: These are beautiful. They are just a little smaller than I thought but very dainty. They are for my daughters birthday and will be perfect for her.

reviews.title: For the price.....?
reviews.text: I am often buying jewelry for my wife, from high-end semi-precious to very precious, indeed. At the super low price I couldn't pass this up. She loves the earrings; wore them out that night. The design is classic and very much perfect. And design is everything. Poor design would make a 5 carat high grade precious stone look crummy. These are very inexpensive and look classy.

reviews.title: Earrings very small and petite - not as pictured
reviews.text: The item did not look at all like it was pictured. It was very small, something a 16 year old woman would wear. And i am a middle age woman. I returned the item.

reviews.title: much smaller than shown
reviews.text: I only got one wearing - the backs are really cheap and I lost one before I got home. Very disappointing.

reviews.title: I Love My Purchase
reviews.text: I bought the earrings as a gift. The shipping was fast and the earrings were exactly as described. I am so pleased with my purchase. I will definitely be a repeat customer.

reviews.title: Simple but luxurious!
reviews.text: I was looking for earrings to go with pearls but had a limitless extra flair to them. These were the perfect answer. They're classic, but elegant!

reviews.title: CHEAP Quality & Looking & Much OVERPRICED
reviews.text: I'm disappointed after opened the box, the bracelet was supposed to be one of the X'mas presents. I ordered it based on the good reviews and the 2-tone charms look elegant on the picture. However, the actual piece is not as good as the picture, the quality is cheap; the weight of the bracelet is plastically light; no craftmanship at all; I wouldn't buy it even US$9. I didn't expect that cheap quality for spending $20- on; I can't accept it and pack it as a gift, and I know the person who i gonna send the gift to won't like it either. I returned it and went to a local store to spend less than $10 for a nice bracelet with real turqoise mid-size stones and small cute frestwater peals; plus free gift box.

reviews.title: Favie
reviews.text: This was my Moms favorite Christmas gift. The gold on silver is so nice. Very detailed and looks expensive! I was surprised by how heavy it is. Comes with a box and a drawstring bag.

reviews.title: Surprisingly Hefty for "Fashion Jewelry"
reviews.text: Great "fashion" version of popular sterling silver charm bracelets - but I can't understand why they didn't put more charms on the bracelet to fill it more. It is sturdy and will fit a 8" wrist easily; I would NOT purchase for a small wrist wearer. Read that, not great for most teens due to the size... I would NOT gift this bracelet because it does have an incomplete look when it shifts positions and the charms are not fully covering the bracelet.

reviews.title: Heart Line Disappointment!!!
reviews.text: I was very disappointed to find this item was plated and not solid silver. You cannot add or change the charms. I guess if you want a Pandora Bracelet that's what you should buy.

reviews.title: Do not waste your money.

reviews.text:
My wife really likes these earrings. They sparkle, are of good size and appear to be well made. I read the reviews, and here is what I have to say. I have a very strong magnet that I also use to test jewelry metals. The magnet attracted the dangles just a little; they did not cling to it. The magnet would not lift them. This would indicate one of two possibilities. First off, Sterling Silver, by definition, consists of 925 parts of fine silver and 75 parts of other metals, usually copper. But Zinc, Germanium and Platinum are also used for specific reasons. None of those are magnetic. So, one possibility is that they are rhodium plated. Cheap rhodium plating may utilize a thin layer of nickel (magnetic). The prize for these does not suggest rhodium plating. That leaves the other possibility that the silver contains a ferrous metal, most likely nickel, in which case it does not qualify for the nomenclature of Sterling. On the upside, I found a tiny 925 stamp on the hooks. The magnet did not attract them. That's a good thing.
So much for academics. These dangle earrings really look nice. They are relatively sturdy and well executed. My wife wears them a lot. She is very happy with…

3) The pendant is stamped 925 JWBR India (so, yes...also silver, but I'm assuming plated not solid silver).

I tried to adjust the pictures so the markings were visible. If your chain or pendant aren't stamped, then you probably got a knock off that isn't silver...not that a knock-off can't stamp the .925 mark on a piece of tin too...but usually the 925 mark indicates real silver.

The Cubic Zirconias are sparkly and well cut and they are set securely. The wires are sturdy and backs worked smoothly. The size of the CZ is perfect for me as they aren't too large to look unbelievable but still have great presence. The weight of the stones will pull them down but I solve this with the little plastic backs you can pick up here, on Amazon, or in any department store. Just place them over the wires after they are through your ears and they will hold the earring in place wherever you want it. This will not interfere with the backs closing.

For what it's worth, I ordered a bag of the little plastic backs long ago and use them on most of my earrings; posts, wires, hoops, and these, to position or doubly secure them and they have saved them many times. The necklace is dainty and not very thick, but holds up well; and you can always use a different necklace with the pendant if you have a nice genuine gold one. The length of the necklace is about 18 inches. This is sold directly from Amazon's own jewelry collection, so I do believe that it's genuine jade like the description states (which is not expensive anyway; it's pricing is the equivalent of what sterling silver would be sold for in jewelry); however this is NOT real gold. "Plated" gold means they took silver and basically dipped it into 18K gold; sterling silver also contains nickel or some other "cheap" metal to harden and make more solid, which means if you're sensitive to metals, you can get an allergic reaction from the nickel, copper, or whatever…

It also comes beautifully presented. It’s put in not one, but two boxes which makes it easier to wrap but also makes the person receiving it think you spent a lot more than what you did on the necklace.

reviews.title: Glitzy Halo CZ Earrings!

The earring findings are about as plain and simple as you can get. It would be nice to see the front of the lever backs just a little wider, smoother, decorated, or somehow more finished.

The earrings are one inch long from the top of the finding to the bottom of the drop and a bit more than 3/8 inch wide, 0.4 inches as noted in the specs. They appear to be well made, the lever backs work smoothly, and the stones are set well. The little heart pattern in the backs is pretty, shiny, and charming.

As you can see in the included pictures, they come in Amazon's nice, little presentation box but there is a large, white "Made in China" tag tied on along with the Swarovski tag. If you remove that tag, I think these would be a much appreciated gift, even if for yourself!

reviews.title: very flat/small tote
reviews.text:
I often need to run a few errands and don't want to carry my whole purse, but just need my wallet and phone, so I thought this might work well.

Unfortunately, it doesn't. It is built very flat, so putting anything in it makes it look funny and ruins its "lines". There isn't a lot of give to put anything in or pull anything out.

The strap is adjustable, which is nice, but even adjusted to its full length, the strap is not long enough - and I have a short torso! The bag stopped above my hip, which was too high.

Construction of the bag seems fine, but it's hard to know how sturdy it will stay over time.

The material is okay, in that I don't think it would fall apart, and it's lined with a different fabric which is a decent quality, and the sewing is good as well. However, the design is very "young," with largish and brightly colored gold zipper and metal connectors (buckle for the strap, attachments of the strap to the purse), and a very goofy looking heart-shaped gold print of the heart/ Lovely Tote emblem on the front. Overall, the impression is that this would be good for girls aged 6-14 or thereabouts. Again, not a bad purse for the younger crowd, but i wouldn't pay nearly $30 for it.

reviews.title: Cute little purse for a tween maybe, but that's about all

It's not very practical in my world to have such a small purse, but it is very cute and would be perfect for a young tween who just needs to carry some lip balm, some tampax, and that's it. There is just one main compartment and it doesn't expand far at all.

The color is just as bright as is depicted in the pic and appears to be made well. The zipper, and all the hardware are a gold tone color, but it's not obnoxious juxtaposed against the bright red. It seems to go well with it actually and appears to be sturdily made.

Overall, it's not something I would buy, especially since my own wallet is bigger than this purse, but if you are into minimalistic simplicity, or looking for a cute little beginner purse for a tween, this would be a cute option.

reviews.title: Decent Shoes
reviews.text:
When I saw these shoes I wasn't sure what to expect. Many times the description over states the actual product you are going to get. These are not perfect by any means, but they are pretty decent.

MATERIALS
These seem to be legit leather. The leather is a little thing for my liking, but it's not too bad. The sole seems to be leather or a similar material, with rubber grips on the toes and heel. The heel seems to be attached with copper nails, which is a nice touch.

QUALITY
These are not bad, but they could be better. The leather is thin, lace holes worry me a little, the souls are stitched on, I'm not sure if the top of the shoe is glued or stitched.

COMFORT
For dress shoes, these are okay. They run on the small side, so get at least a half size larger. If you have a wide foot, make it a full size larger. There is some cushioning inside the shoe.

Overall, you can find better shoes. If you like the look of these, they are worth a shot. They have some quirky things to them, like the odd strip of leather on the heel.

This is really a case where I wish I could give half stars. They are not bad enough to be a three, but a four is a little high.

I ordered these Amazon Brand’s Men’s shoes for me to attend semi formal and informal events as soon as the pandemic restrictions are lifted. I have only worn it once around the neighborhood and I wasn’t too pleased with the fitting. The shoes were a bit too snug with my usual socks. I had to switch to very thin socks to get more comfortable and though I like that they are a bit easy to put on and take off. I had the shoes on for several hours with the thin socks on with little discomfort considering they are brand new shoes. I do like the basic and simple design, the stitch detailing around the upper front of the shoes, and my favorite features are the Derby lace-up and the synthetic outsoles. The lace-ups are pretty user-friendly, and I like that the rubber outsoles are really “grippy” with nice textured surfaces that do quite well on a variety of surfaces without slipping. I like that they are lightweight, breathable, and easy on the feet, and the shoes seem to be made of good suede materials and they appear to be durable, and sturdy.
I like that these suede shoes match some of my pants and shirts. For those with wide feet, check the width very well for better fitting.

These shoes turned out to be very comfortable. My husband wears between a 10.5 and 11 and this 11 was a fairly snug fit, so order up half a size if you have larger feet. The toe is slightly long, but because his second toe is longer than the first, this is exactly what he always looks for.

He says they're very comfortable for driving and feel soft and comfortable "like slippers" when he's sitting. But what impressed me is that he wore them for our two-mile morning walk and came home with very happy feet.

These casual shoes are slightly padded and very well stitched. The soles are firm gum and have traction. All in all, he's very happy with these shoes.

I ordered this bag for my son. He's in middle school and takes the bus, so he has to carry maybe 15 lbs worth of books and supplies every day. He's been using this bag for a few weeks and loves it, and so far it is holding up well.

Some great points to the bag, it has a lot of storage space, while still being small enough to carry comfortably. Fully open it's about 21" long, 8" deep, and 12" wide. There are multiple pockets on the outside for storing pens, calculators, etc. On the inside it has two pockets that he uses for his agenda, but it could also hold laptop. His two mega 3-ring binders fit in the middle, along with multiple books. There's a holder on the back for an umbrella, and a hole on top to run a cable if you wanted to plug in headphones, or something.

The bag feels very durable. The bottom is reinforced and feels solid. The material and zippers also feel very durable and well-constructed.

Also, if you aren't familiar with roll-top bags, the benefit is that if you aren't using that space you can adjust the bag size. Also the large opening on top makes it easier to see everything inside and fit large items. Neat concept. This would make a great bag for anyone:…
